newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat signs deal with Polish tech. school.
newsitem.headline: Fiat signs deal with Polish tech. school.

text.p: Fiat has signed a technical cooperation deal involving its research division, Centro Ricerche Fiat, its Polish offshoot Fiat Polska and engineering schools in Warsaw and Silesia.

A Fiat statement said the aim of the deal was to improve the training of students and graduates from the schools in areas of potential interest to Fiat companies operating in Poland. These include Fiat Auto, Magneti Marelli and Teksid.
Under the agreement on-the-job training for teachers and students would be encouraged and scholarships and technical assistance aimed at encouraging innovation would also be made available.
Fiat Auto has a 43 percent share of the Polish car market, the statement said. Milan newsroom +392-66102321
